description: Agent Control: submit an escalation policy for when something is already going wrong: triggers as written or as metric, operator, value and window, each with its action class, owner, response time and when it moves to the next owner, plus the action classes it must cover and the named owners. The signed report names every trigger stated as a judgment rather than a condition an operator could apply at 3 AM, every action class with no named escalation owner and every trigger with no time bound, with the fix for each. Approval before acting is wever_action-threshold-check. Verdict judgment_based, partly_operable or operable. POST /api/escalation-threshold-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-control-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-control/.

action_classes.description: Action classes the policy must cover.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

escalate_after.description: When it moves to the next owner if unanswered.
